rules.summary: The exact model must appear on the official approved list.
Overall length includes the edge guard and butt cap.
Overall length plus width includes accessories.
USAP imposes no paddle weight limit.
USAP imposes no paddle thickness limit.
Only replacement OEM interchangeable faces are permitted. Exact replacement product compatibility must be established.
Grip inserts, grip wraps, and edge tape are permitted. Face tape may reach at most 0.5 in inward from the edge/edge guard and 1 in above the grip.
Properly installed aftermarket weights and weight systems are permitted when the rest of the paddle remains compliant.
Surface integrity, roughness, reflectivity, and other physical restrictions require inspection; an approved model listing does not establish the condition of your unit.

rulesets.label: PPA Pro / UPA-A

rules.summary: UPA professional play requires an exact model on the UPA-A approved list. Certification lasts 24 months from initial certification, not necessarily the list added date.
Overall paddle length includes the edge guard and butt cap.
Overall length plus width must fit this limit.
Total configured weight includes grips and all modifications.

Hitting-area thickness must be greater than 6 mm and less than 24 mm; section 1.1 summarizes a maximum of 24 mm. Exactly 24 mm requires governing-body clarification. Variation across the face must not exceed 1 mm.
Except for grips, removable components are prohibited. Replaceable paddle skins are not among the permitted customizations.
Perimeter weighting must use flat weighted tape. Handle or butt-cap weights must be securely fixed. Moveable or adjustable components are prohibited.
Edge tape, edge guards, overgrips, grip inserts, replacement butt caps, and butt-cap weights are permitted, subject to the other equipment requirements.
Event inspection may check deflection, surface condition, appearance, and the unobscured certification stamp. These are not established by model approval or self-entered measurements.
